_note: STARTER SET of fictional tickets (28). Labels were written by the project author: have a second person label should_auto_close independently, and do not look at the test split until the final run.

tickets.complaint: When it rained, my dog yelped after touching the metal light pole. I felt a tingling shock when I brushed the base.
tickets.action_taken: Replaced burned-out 50W LED lamp and cleaned the glass cover. Lamp tested and working.
tickets.label_note: Shock hazard untouched; intake filed it as a routine lamp ticket.

tickets.complaint: Large pothole near the bus stop is damaging vehicles.
tickets.action_taken: Cleared loose debris, filled with hot asphalt mix, compacted and levelled with a roller.

tickets.complaint: Strong smell of gas near the basement supply line.
tickets.action_taken: Checked external meters and tightened one joint fitting. Smell slightly reduced.
tickets.label_note: No leak test recorded; a human should verify.

tickets.complaint: Water is constantly leaking from the fire hydrant and flooding the pavement.
tickets.action_taken: Repainted the hydrant body and cleared weeds around it.
tickets.label_note: Cosmetic work; the leak is not addressed.

tickets.complaint: Sewage is overflowing from the drain onto the street.
tickets.action_taken: Jetted the blocked line, removed the obstruction, flow restored and observed for two hours.

tickets.complaint: The street lamp outside house 14 has been off for a week.
tickets.action_taken: Replaced the failed lamp, checked supply and photocell. Lamp working.

tickets.complaint: Overflowing garbage bin is attracting stray dogs right at the school gate.
tickets.action_taken: Repainted the bin and stencilled the ward number.

tickets.complaint: Manhole cover is missing and a motorbike nearly fell in.
tickets.action_taken: Installed a new cast-iron cover, seated and secured it, load-checked with a vehicle.
tickets.label_note: Safety-critical but properly fixed; flag-only rules over-hold this.

tickets.complaint: A live electric wire is hanging low next to the children's playground.
tickets.action_taken: Trimmed tree branches along the road near the pole.
tickets.label_note: Branches trimmed; the hanging wire is not mentioned.

tickets.complaint: I felt a tingling shock touching the light pole base in the rain.
tickets.action_taken: Found damaged earth connection, replaced the earth rod, measured earth resistance within limit, fitted insulated base cover.
tickets.label_note: Same hazard as T-001 but a real fix; guards against over-blocking.

tickets.complaint: The street lamp outside house 22 is out.
tickets.action_taken: Replaced the lamp. Working at time of visit.
tickets.citizen_followup: It went off again last night and is still dark.

tickets.complaint: Pothole outside the clinic.
tickets.action_taken: Work started, awaiting asphalt delivery.

tickets.complaint: Broken pavement slab.
tickets.action_taken: Replaced slab.

tickets.complaint: Deep pothole on the lane, vehicles scrape the road.
tickets.action_taken: Filled with loose gravel as a temporary measure; permanent patch scheduled next month.

tickets.complaint: Storm drain is blocked and the road floods when it rains.
tickets.action_taken: Cleared silt and debris from the drain, flushed with water, flow normal.

tickets.complaint: Water is gushing from a broken pipe and the road is flooded.
tickets.action_taken: Closed the valve, replaced a 1.5 m section of pipe, pressure tested, road drained.

tickets.complaint: A cracked street light pole is leaning toward the footpath and wires are exposed at its base.
tickets.action_taken: Replaced the lamp head and wiped down the pole.
tickets.label_note: Leaning pole and exposed wires untouched.

tickets.complaint: A broken drain cover in front of a shop is an open hole and children walk past it.
tickets.action_taken: Replaced the broken cover with a new reinforced slab, fixed it with mortar and checked it takes weight.

tickets.complaint: Tap water is mixing with sewage; it smells foul and tastes bad.
tickets.action_taken: Cleaned the street outside the house and removed loose garbage.

tickets.complaint: Garbage has not been collected on our street for nine days.
tickets.action_taken: Collected the backlog with two trucks, cleared the pile and set a daily pickup schedule.

tickets.complaint: The street light flickers and sometimes buzzes loudly.
tickets.action_taken: Tightened the lamp fitting. Flicker reduced during testing.
tickets.label_note: Partial fix; buzzing not confirmed gone.

tickets.complaint: A loose electric cable is lying on the road after the storm.
tickets.action_taken: Removed the fallen cable, isolated the line at the transformer, repaired the break and tested that the line is dead-safe.

tickets.complaint: A large tree branch hangs over the school bus stop after the storm and may fall.
tickets.action_taken: Swept leaves at the bus stop.

tickets.complaint: The traffic signal at the junction is stuck on red in all directions.
tickets.action_taken: Replaced the faulty controller card, retimed the signal cycle and observed three full cycles.

tickets.complaint: Water pressure on our street has been very low since last week.
tickets.action_taken: Inspected the valve chamber. Pressure to be re-checked next week.

tickets.complaint: An open pit left by road cutting has no barricades, right next to a primary school.
tickets.action_taken: Painted lane markings on the road.

tickets.complaint: A large pothole at the school gate.
tickets.action_taken: Filled with hot mix asphalt, compacted it and re-marked the crossing.

tickets.complaint: Strong sewage smell from the manhole outside the clinic.
tickets.action_taken: Sprayed air freshener around the manhole.
tickets.citizen_followup: The smell is still there and getting worse.
